title: MM6 Hydra
description: Native MM6 five-headed Hydra: coiled low olive-green serpentine body with dark brown patches, tapering upcurled rattling tail, NO legs and five long individually colored serpentine necks. Purple head with white horns, green head, red head with gold crest/fins, blue head, yellow-green head. Keep all five heads and their exact native overlap, horn/fin shapes, belly plates, neck lengths and coiled snake body. No extra heads, limbs, spikes, equipment or ground shadow.
